from pathlib import Path
import importlib.util,json,types,unittest
from unittest import mock
ROOT=Path('/Users/dave/.codex/worktrees/9f01/dataflowbench')
ACQ=ROOT/'reports/releases/v0.9.2/acquisition'
def load(name,path):
    spec=importlib.util.spec_from_file_location(name,path)
    module=importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec);spec.loader.exec_module(module);return module
f=load('codeql03_bf_fixture',ACQ/'test-bifrost-v0140-replacement-11.py');p=f.p;b=f.b
class CodeQL03Paths(f.IncomingSealTests):
    def setUp(self):
        super().setUp()
        self.recovery=self.put('reports/releases/v0.9.2/acquisition/independent-pending-codeql-03.py',b'# isolated synthetic provider; never production evidence\n')
        self.manifest=self.put('reports/releases/v0.9.2/qualification/independent-pending-groups-01/codeql-continuation-manifest-03.json',b'{"terminal_outcome":{"mode":"pending"}}\n')
    def test_bridge_routes_exact_sealed02_module_and_pending_manifest(self):
        core=self.core('failed');prefix=(self.root/core['continuation_prefix']['path']).read_bytes()
        expected={'base':{'validated':{}},'contexts':{},'repaired':{'validated':{}},'prefix_sha256':p.sha256(prefix)}
        recover=mock.Mock(return_value=expected);provider=types.SimpleNamespace(recover_bifrost_history=recover)
        spec=types.SimpleNamespace(loader=types.SimpleNamespace(exec_module=lambda module:None))
        with mock.patch.object(b.importlib.util,'spec_from_file_location',return_value=spec),mock.patch.object(b.importlib.util,'module_from_spec',return_value=p),mock.patch.object(b,'_load_module',return_value=provider) as loader:
            self.assertIs(b._incoming_recovery(self.root,core),expected)
        self.assertEqual(loader.call_args.args,(self.root,'independent_codeql_history',self.recovery))
        recover.assert_called_once_with(self.root,self.manifest['path'],self.manifest['sha256'],prefix)
    def test_changed02_provider_bytes_rejected_by_actual_seal_validator(self):
        core=self.core('completed');(self.root/self.recovery['path']).write_bytes(b'# changed\n')
        with self.assertRaises(ValueError):p._validate_historical_prefixes(self.root,core)
    def test_source05_accepts_new02_contract_path_and_exact_incoming_identity(self):
        old=json.loads((ROOT/p.SOURCE_DESIGN_04['path']).read_bytes())
        incoming={'source_commit':'d'*40,'plan_commit':'e'*40,'contract':{'path':'reports/releases/v0.9.2/execution-v4/continuations/codeql-independent-pending-03-contract.json','sha256':'f'*64}}
        keys=['historical_outputs_immutable','historical_evidence_strategy','actual_historical_bifrost_contexts','actual_historical_bifrost_rows','allowed_source_delta','unchanged_source_patch']
        design={k:old[k] for k in keys}
        design.update(schema='v092-bifrost-source-post-codeql-rebase/v1',predecessor_design=p.SOURCE_DESIGN_04,scheduling_authority=p.BREADTH_FIRST_AUTHORITY,reviewed_baseline_head=old['actual_observed_head'],incoming_codeql=incoming,immediate_patch_base='e'*40,reviewed_intervening_changes=[])
        design_ref=self.put(p.SOURCE_DESIGN_05_PATH,p.canonical_json(design));self.put(p.SOURCE_DESIGN_04['path'],(ROOT/p.SOURCE_DESIGN_04['path']).read_bytes())
        self.assertEqual(p.validate_source_design(self.root,{'source_design':design_ref,'continuation':incoming})['incoming_codeql'],incoming)
        changed=dict(incoming,contract=dict(incoming['contract'],sha256='0'*64))
        with self.assertRaisesRegex(ValueError,'actual incoming'):p.validate_source_design(self.root,{'source_design':design_ref,'continuation':changed})
if __name__=='__main__':unittest.main(verbosity=2)
